summary: Brookfield Corporation filed a Form 6-K attaching a September 21, 2026 press release announcing the pricing of $600 million of senior notes due 2031 at 5.650% per annum. Notes are issued by Brookfield Finance Inc., an indirect wholly-owned subsidiary, and fully guaranteed by Brookfield. Closing expected September 23, 2026, subject to customary conditions; proceeds for general corporate purposes. Offered under an existing base shelf prospectus and Form F-10 registration statement, with Deutsche Bank and BofA as joint book-running managers. This is a routine shelf takedown, not a special situation; watch spread and pricing appetite.
